question: Who chaired 'Aarogya Manthan' 2.0 to celebrate the 2ⁿd anniversary of Ayushman Bharat-Pradhan Mantri Jan Aarogya Yojana?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr Harsh Vardhan.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Dr Harsh Vardhan__, Union Minister for Health and Family Welfare chaired ‘Aarogya Manthan’ 2.0 on 22 September 2020.
 
• This was a part of the celebrations of the 2nd Anniversary of** Ayushman Bharat- Pradhan Mantri Jan Aarogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY).**
 
• He also launched the AB PMJAY Joint Certification Programme and released the “AB PMJAY Anti-Fraud Framework: Practitioners’ Guidebook".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Ayushman Bharat launched in 2018**, a flagship scheme of the Government of India, was launched as recommended by the National Health Policy 2017, to achieve the vision of Universal Health Coverage (UHC).
 
• Ayushman Bharat is a Centrally Sponsered Scheme.
 
• Ayushman Bharat meets to design Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and its underlining commitment, which is to leave no one behind.
 
• Ayushman Bharat has two inter-related components.
 
 
• Health And Wellness Centre
 
• Pradhan Mantri Jan Aarogya Yojana
